extracted.intended_audience: IP managers, patent analysts, licensing negotiators, SEP owners and implementers, and business strategists working on 5G/telecom patents
extracted.subtask_description: Using the five SEP OmniLytics charts to analyze 5G standard-essential-patent (SEP) landscapes, company portfolios, geographic deployment, technology distributions, remaining life, and technical-specification mappings for competitor analysis and licensing decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Top declarers — Who is leading the 5G SEP race?
rubrics_metrics.description: Chart showing overall declaration numbers so users can get a glance at which companies are leading in declared 5G SEPs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use one-click and advanced filters when viewing overall declaration status to adjust scope (e.g., 5G landscape filter). This is useful for quickly assessing leadership in declaration counts; be mindful that declaration counts alone may not reflect portfolio relevance or claim validity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global coverage — Where and how are SEPs deployed?
rubrics_metrics.description: Shows the number of patents a company has in each country and provides a breakdown of their legal status to examine which target markets are covered and the validity of each market.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access via Company Profile dashboard under the 'As a Current Owner' tab. Use this chart for competitor analysis or licensing negotiations, especially when discussing global vs regional licensing rates. Review legal statuses before and during licensing talks. Leverage standardized company trees to view groups and avoid missing subsidiaries (use the Affiliates button).

rubrics_metrics.name: Working groups – Who has been declaring what?
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of declared SEPs' technology distribution and the major application areas that each company is invested in (i.e., which 3GPP workgroups/tech bodies companies contributed to).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helpful for SEP owners conducting competitor analysis (find competitors in the same RAN group) and for implementers to foresee potential licensors. You can view company-specific contributions (e.g., Qualcomm across tech bodies) via the Company Profile dashboard. Use filters to select specific 3GPP workgroups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Remaining life — How sustainable is a SEP holder’s patent portfolio?
rubrics_metrics.description: Chart that allows inspection of the sustainability of a company's SEPs in each jurisdiction by showing remaining patent life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Found on the Company Profile dashboard alongside Global Coverage and Legal Status charts. Use remaining-life data to assess portfolio longevity and plan licensing strategy or enforcement timing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical specifications — Who are the specialized leaders in each technology?
rubrics_metrics.description: Maps 3GPP technical specifications found in standards to declared SEPs, allowing exploration of detailed SEP technology segments and the SEPs correlated with specific specifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: View under the 'As a Declaring Company' tab for company-level detail. Extracted lists of patents are valuable for competitor research, licensing risk evaluation, and industry research in specific domains (e.g., enterprise private networks, microcells). Use this chart to identify specialized leaders by technical segment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data integration and quality (ETSI declarations + patent office data)
rubrics_metrics.description: SEP OmniLytics integrates ETSI declaration data with patent databases from patent offices worldwide and applies curation, cleansing, standardization, warehousing, and verification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This data processing addresses ETSI's basic search limitations and lack of standardization, enabling links to corresponding full-text patents and bibliographic data. Rely on the tool's curated/standardized data rather than raw ETSI search results for analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of filters and dashboard navigation
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the default '5G landscape' filter, advanced filters, and the dashboard tabs (ETSI SEP Overview, Company Profile) to adjust data scope and focus analyses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enable the 5G landscape filter to confine charts to declarations that meet the 5G definition. Use advanced filters (upper-right) and one-click filters to target specific workgroups, time frames, companies, or jurisdictions for tailored insights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Company tree & affiliates standardization
rubrics_metrics.description: Standardized company trees let users view SEPs via corporate groups and avoid the hassle of identifying subsidiary affiliations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Affiliates button on the dashboard to inspect affiliate relationships; this prevents under- or over-counting patents when performing group-level portfolio analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Real-time monitoring of ETSI declaring activity
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to monitor the latest ETSI SEP declaring activity in real-time via the SEP OmniLytics dashboards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use real-time feeds to stay current on new declarations and rapidly-evolving declaration patterns, which is important for timely licensing strategy, enforcement decisions, and market intelligence.
